NameTranslationKey.Description: Translation key for NPC name display

LeashDistance.Description: Distance from the leash point before the NPC wants to return home

LeashMinPlayerDistance.Description: The NPC will not give up the chase while the player is closer than this

LeashTimer.Description: Seconds beyond leash range, without damage or a close player, before the NPC returns home

HardLeashDistance.Description: Absolute maximum distance from the leash point before the NPC returns home unconditionally

ViewRange.Description: The view range of the NPC

ViewSector.Description: The view sector of the NPC

HearingRange.Description: The hearing range of the NPC

AbsoluteDetectionRange.Description: The range at which an entity is guaranteed to be detected

WanderRadius.Description: The wander radius of the NPC

IdleWalkWeight.Description: The weight of the walk behavior

IdleRunWeight.Description: The weight of the run behavior

IdleAnimationWeight.Description: The weight of the animation behavior (with the NPC standing still)

IdleBlockWeight.Description: The weight of the idle flavour state behavior

AlertedRange.Description: The alerted range of the NPC

VoidFleeGoblinNearbyCount.Description: The maximum nearby Goblin count that causes this Goblin to flee

VoidFleeGoblinNearbyRange.Description: The range used to count nearby Goblins

VoidFleeDistance.Description: How far a Goblin will flee from nearby Void creatures. This should be higher than any detection range to avoid state loops

VoidFleeDelay.Description: How long a Goblin will wait before starting to flee from Void creatures

VoidFleeRunAnimation.Description: The animation that plays when the Goblin is running away from a Void creature

VoidFleeScaredAnimation.Description: The animation that plays when the Goblin is fleeing from a Void creature

ChaseNPCGroup.Description: The group of NPCs the goblin will recreationally chase around

ChaseMaxDuration.Description: The max duration of the chase behaviour, after which the NPC will return to idling

ChaseFrequency.Description: The time period between consecutive chases

FlavorAllBlockset.Description: The block set used for the initial flavor query. WARNING: must contain all blocks in the flavor sets!

FlavorDigBlockset.Description: The block set this NPC will dig through

FlavorMirrorBlockset.Description: The block set in front of which the NPC will admire themselves

FlavorSitBlockset.Description: The blockset the NPC will sit around

JuggleSpectateDistance.Description: The distance at which this NPC will spectate juggles

JuggleFailFleeDistance.Description: The distance to which this NPC will flee when fleeing from a failed juggle

AlertedTimeout.Description: The time range after which an NPC will transition from alerted to combat

ThrowItemInteraction.Description: The interaction that runs when the NPC throws an item at another

BrawlGroups.Description: The groups of NPCs this NPC will brawl with

BrawlGroupsInform.Description: The groups brawling will be advertised to

BrawlAltitudeRange.Description: The altitude range between two NPCs at which brawls can be initiated or detected

BrawlAttack.Description: The attack interaction that runs when two NPCs brawl eachother

BrawlAttackDistance.Description: The distance at which this NPC will brawl another

BrawlAttackPauseRange.Description: The time delay between consecutive brawl attacks

BrawlAttackWinChance.Description: The probability each punch will win the fight for the NPC

BrawlMaxDuration.Description: The time range after which the NPCs will give up on the brawl

BrawlAnimationWin.Description: The animation that plays when it wins a brawl

BrawlAnimationLose.Description: The animation that plays when an NPC gives up on the brawl

BrawlSpectateDistance.Description: The distance at which this NPC will spectate brawls

CombatMessageRange.Description: The range at which the NPC will send/receive combat messages

CombatMessageTargetGroups.Description: The NPC groups the combat message will be sent to

CombatMessageAcceptChance.Description: The chance an NPC will respond to a combat beacon

Attack.Description: The attack interaction the NPC will use

AttackDistance.Description: The distance at which the NPC will perform the attack interaction

AttackPauseRange.Description: The time delay between consecutive attacks

CombatBehaviorDistance.Description: The distance at which the NPC will switch to combat-oriented movement

CombatMovingRelativeSpeed.Description: The relative speed at which the NPC will perform combat movement (strafing, etc)

CombatBackOffDistanceRange.Description: The distance to which the NPC will back off after attacking

CombatDirectWeight.Description: The weight of the direct behaviour

CombatFallBackWeight.Description: The probability an NPC will fall back to a nearby Glutton when below 50% HP

CombatFallBackDurationRange.Description: How long the NPC will remain in the fall back state

ConfusedTimeRange.Description: The time during which the NPC will be confused

SearchTimeRange.Description: The time during which the NPC will search for a target

MemoriesUnlockedBy.Description: How the player records the memory, either Proximity or Kill.

MemoriesKillRange.Description: Radius in blocks in which the memory is recorded when the NPC dies. 0 uses the server default.

AttitudeGroup.Description: Attitude group the goblin belongs to.

DisableDamageGroups.Description: Attitude groups whose damage this goblin ignores.
